title: Alfredo Sauce
summary: Cream, butter, garlic, and Parmesan, with an egg yolk for body. Ten minutes on the stove.

steps.title: Cream and yolk
steps.text: Whisk the cream and egg yolk together and set aside.

steps.title: Garlic butter
steps.text: Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium-high and cook the garlic until fragrant and sizzling.

steps.title: Heat the cream
steps.text: Pour in the cream mixture, turn the heat to medium, and stir often until hot but not boiling. Boiling will scramble the yolk.

steps.title: Parmesan
steps.text: Whisk in the Parmesan a little at a time and keep whisking over medium until creamy and thickened. Season with pepper.

notes: Makes about 1 3/4 cups, enough for roughly 1 lb of fettuccine (4 servings). Multiply by 2.5 for the family. To add wine: after the garlic, add about 1/2 cup dry white (Pinot Grigio or Sauvignon Blanc) and reduce until nearly gone before the cream goes in. Also good over seared chicken for chicken Alfredo.
